content.short: Term Finance provides digital asset lending for institutions, with transparency and low costs.
content.description: The Term Finance system provides noncustodial, fixed-rate collateral lending inspired by traditional tri-party repo arrangements. It conducts recurring auctions in which borrowers submit sealed bids and lenders present offers to determine the market-clearing rate. Bids above the rate secure loans, while offers below the rate help fund them. Any unmatched bids or offers remain open. After each auction, borrowers receive loan proceeds and lenders receive ERC-20 tokens for redemption. Smart contracts manage repayments and collateral custody.
content.meta: Term Finance is a noncustodial DeFi lending protocol offering fixed-rate collateral loans. Discover Term Finance and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
